svg.title: Screen Age concept and causal FIR calibration
svg.desc: Panel A uses an attributed real-world frame to illustrate a current estimated FIR screen and a sparse history of earlier estimated positions. The history is explanatory, not BIWI test imagery. Panel B is driven by aggregate BIWI measurements and shows that six registered FIR designs recover analytic delays of seven, eleven, and nineteen frames in development and held-out diagnostics.

g.text: A filtered screen carries temporal history.
Real scene · estimated FIR screen · illustrated history
Aggregate calibration evidence appears at right.
